item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Hydration. Your day has a lot of structure in it, but nothing in it covers water, so it won't happen by default. Drinking enough keeps your focus steady and your mood even, which supports the calm you're already working toward. Don't wait until you feel thirsty, because that's already late. Tie sips to things you already do, like a walk or a check-in. Action: fill a large glass of water right now and finish it.
